mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.health_examination_sessions WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_sessions SET session_date=#{s.sessionDate},activity=#{s.activity},site_type=#{s.siteType},site_address=#{s.siteAddress}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{s.id} AND organization_id=#{s.organizationId} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND status='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_sessions WHERE organization_id=#{organizationId} AND session_date=#{sessionDate} AND site_type=#{siteType} AND site_address=#{siteAddress} AND activity=#{activity} AND status='OPEN' AND id <> #{excludeId})
mapper.sql: s.id,s.organization_id,s.agreement_id,s.session_date,s.activity,s.site_type,s.site_address,s.status, COUNT(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('ASSIGNED','ATTENDED')) AS assigned_count, COUNT(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'ATTENDED') AS attended_count, COUNT(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'NO_SHOW') AS no_show_count, s.created_at,s.updated_at,s.row_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.health_examination_sessions s LEFT JOIN public.health_examination_session_assignments a ON a.session_id=s.id WHERE s.id=#{id} AND s.organization_id=#{organizationId} GROUP BY s.id
